d:
Finally, after over 2 months of slacking off, I've done another Raeza set. This one could be a bit too small since this scene doesn't have a lot of variety of locations (well, being a private jet with only a handful of identical chairs and small tables), sorry if that's a problem. I picked this particular scene because I liked the soft lighting.

In this set I also did what I think is the first "kinda ahegao" pose (or whatever) I've ever attempted (the one where Raeza takes her wet fingers out of her mouth after sucking on them); I actually enjoyed making that pose a lot.

I think the next set I'm making will likely take place in the same scene as the previous one (the neon pool) since I really liked the way Raeza's skin looked among the lighting and the general color scheme of that scene. I won't make any promises as to when the next set is done since I do this stuff whenever I have both motivation and time, but hopefully it won't take as long as this one took (damn, I'm starting to talk like there's a whole lot of people who actually care about my uploads here, huh).

As always, our beloved little goddess Raeza is courtesy of Zixaphir: https://x.com/zixaphir
